last_amend_reason:
ESC-019, GRANTED BY HANK IN SESSION 2026-09-04 ('Cool, yeah, then do it.'). The frozen E8 runbook test now grades EXECUTABILITY instead of SHAPE. .swarm-loop/acceptance/test_e8_proofs.py ONLY; no metric, target, direction, command, tolerance, product file, dependency or ticket changed.

WHY IT WAS WRONG. The test certified docs/demo/starting-slice.md by asserting its make targets are DEFINED. It never asked whether their recipes resolve. It therefore read 8/8 green, for an unknown number of cycles, while BOTH of the runbook's headline commands failed: e2e/test_s1_flow.py did not exist, and make e2e-live shelled to docs/demo/e2e_live.sh, which nobody had written. A shape check certifies the next broken runbook identically.

WHY NOW AND NOT EARLIER — THIS IS HANK'S OWN SEQUENCING FROM ESC-018. He ruled: land the executability check in the NON-FROZEN tier first, then make the runbook's claims TRUE, and only then revisit the frozen gate, 'since doing it after the runbook is executable costs nothing where doing it first deliberately reds a confirmed-green board.' Both prior steps are complete and measured, so this amendment lands GREEN: E8 stays 8, acceptance stays 120 collected and 100.00 pass rate, measured immediately before and after.

WHAT CHANGED, precisely. Three assertions were removed and replaced: 'e2e-live in referenced', 'makefile.is_file()', and 'not missing' — the entire shape half. ZERO test functions were removed, all 8 @pytest.mark.ticket markers are intact, the test keeps its name and its epic/ticket markers (E8 / T-085), and the SECTION-heading half of its body is byte-identical, because deleting that would have silently dropped T-085 acceptance 2 from a frozen file. Sections 1-5 and 7-8 of the file are unchanged.

PROVED THREE WAYS BEFORE APPLYING. (a) GREEN NOW: 8 passed, run through the frozen runner's own flags. (b) RED ON THE OLD WORLD: against a copy of the tree with e2e_live.sh and test_s1_flow.py removed, it fails and NAMES ALL FOUR broken commands with their file:line and the reason each does not resolve. (c) BYPASS BATTERY: 49 cases, 47 as expected — fence relabels (there is no fence model to relabel around; the sweep is line-oriented over raw text), recipe operands with no directory component, an invented recipe head, an unassigned make variable, a target with no recipe, a script that fails bash -n, 18 command-position spellings, bash -c, a markdown table cell, an unclassifiable  head, a hostile pyproject addopts, a hostile python_files, and PYTEST_ADDOPTS in the environment — all caught with the verdict unmoved; three false-positive probes on ordinary English stayed quiet.

TWO HOLES ARE DECLARED IN THE FROZEN DOCSTRING RATHER THAN HIDDEN, because nobody may edit this file afterwards without waking the user: uv/pytest/node take subcommands in the operand slot, so 'uv sync --script no_such.py' is not graded (though 'uv run python -m pytest <path>' IS); and docker compose is graded as an external tool, never against the compose config, because this suite's module scope is stdlib-and-pytest only and cannot parse YAML — so a step naming a non-existent compose service passes. It also closed a hole nobody asked about: the predecessor took only the first make operand, so 'make lint types' left 'types' ungraded.

HERMETIC, and this matters because a frozen metric that reads outside the manifest is not frozen. It requires NO environment variable of its own — not even PROXYSHOP_WORKER — and actively strips PYTEST_ADDOPTS and PYTHONPATH from both of its subprocesses. Those subprocesses are read-only by construction: 'python -B -E -s -c find_spec' (-E -s drop PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME/user-site) and 'pytest --collect-only --noconftest -p no:cacheprovider -o addopts= -o pythonpath='. --noconftest is load-bearing: no root conftest means no D38 worker guard and NO POSSIBILITY OF TOUCHING WORKER 0'S DATABASE, which is the same worker the build_succeeds metric runs on. bash -n parses without executing; --collect-only collects without running. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 so grading the tree does not modify it. Verified identical under PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 and without it.

ARMED BEFORE ANY CONCLUSION: the Makefile must parse to at least one target, the sweep must extract at least one command, at least five must name something resolvable, all three resolvable categories must be present, no resolvable-category command may grade INFO, and a second backtick-and-fence-blind raw scan must be fully covered by graded commands on the same line. The UNCLASSIFIED bucket is counted and printed on the passing path as well as the failing one.
